moments.title: Bake Off Returns with New Judge
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off's 16th season kicked off on September 2nd, introducing Nigella Lawson as a new judge alongside Paul Hollywood, Alison Hammond, and Noel Fielding.

source.l: The Cake & Bake Show / The Version

angles.name: Bake Off is back!
angles.copy: The tent is open! Great British Bake Off is back for another season of soggy bottoms and showstoppers. Who's your early favourite for Star Baker?

angles.name: Nigella joins Bake Off
angles.copy: New judge alert! Nigella Lawson has joined Paul Hollywood in the Bake Off tent. Are you tuning in to see her culinary critiques?

moments.title: Cardiff City Away Day
moments.blurb: Cardiff City travel to Fratton Park to face Portsmouth in the Championship on Saturday, September 5th.

angles.name: Cardiff Away Game
angles.copy: Bluebirds on the road! Cardiff City head to Portsmouth this Saturday in the Championship. Will they bring home three points?

moments.title: Swansea City Host Wrexham
moments.blurb: Swansea City welcome Wrexham to the Swansea.com Stadium for a Championship clash this Saturday, September 5th.

angles.name: South Wales Derby Lite
angles.copy: It's a big one for the Swans! Swansea City host Wrexham in the Championship on Saturday. Who's ready for a cracker?

moments.title: Exeter City vs Walsall
moments.blurb: Exeter City play their next League Two match at home against Walsall this Saturday, September 5th, at St James Park.

angles.name: Grecians Home Game
angles.copy: Matchday! Exeter City are at home to Walsall this Saturday. Get down to St James Park and cheer on the Grecians!

moments.title: West Ham Host Derby County
moments.blurb: West Ham United face Derby County at the London Stadium in a Championship fixture on Saturday, September 5th.

angles.name: Hammers at Home
angles.copy: It's a big London clash! West Ham United host Derby County at the London Stadium this Saturday. Can the Hammers continue their winning momentum?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Beyoncé!
moments.blurb: Global superstar Beyoncé celebrates her 45th birthday on September 4th. She rose to fame with Destiny's Child before an iconic solo career.

angles.name: Queen Bey's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 45th Birthday to the one and only Queen Bey, Beyoncé! What's your favourite track from this living legend?

moments.title: Happy 51st Birthday, Mark Ronson!
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning DJ, songwriter, and record producer Mark Ronson turns 51 on September 4th, known for hits like 'Uptown Funk' and 'Valerie'.

angles.name: Mark Ronson's Big Day
angles.copy: Sending birthday vibes to the incredible Mark Ronson, turning 51 today! What's your go-to Mark Ronson produced banger?

moments.title: British Country Music Festival
moments.blurb: The British Country Music Festival takes place from September 4th to 6th in Blackpool, featuring UK and international country and Americana artists.

angles.name: Country Music in Blackpool
angles.copy: Yee-haw! The British Country Music Festival kicks off today in Blackpool. Who's heading north for a weekend of country and Americana?

moments.title: Big London Tattoo Show
moments.blurb: The UK's largest tattoo and alternative lifestyle event, the Big London Tattoo Show, runs from September 4th to 6th at ExCeL London.

angles.name: London Tattoo Show
angles.copy: Ink lovers, unite! The Big London Tattoo Show is on this weekend at ExCeL. What's your favourite piece of body art?

moments.title: End of the Road Festival
moments.blurb: The End of the Road Festival, a multi-genre music festival, continues until September 6th.

angles.name: Festival Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: Still soaking up the atmosphere at End of the Road Festival! Who's there and what's been your highlight so far?

moments.title: Lindisfarne Festival Ongoing
moments.blurb: Lindisfarne Festival, an independent music and arts festival, runs until September 6th in Northumberland.

angles.name: Northumberland Festival Fun
angles.copy: The party continues at Lindisfarne Festival! If you're there, let us know what you're loving most about this year's lineup!

moments.title: Champions League Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League group stage begins with Matchday 1 on September 8th and 9th, featuring UK teams Manchester City, Aston Villa, Liverpool, and Arsenal in action.

angles.name: European Nights Return
angles.copy: The Champions League is back! UK giants are in action this week as the group stage gets underway. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Man City & Villa in Europe
angles.copy: Manchester City and Aston Villa kick off their Champions League campaigns on Tuesday! Big away days for both. Can they start with a win?

angles.name: Liverpool & Arsenal CL
angles.copy: Wednesday night Champions League football! Liverpool host Atletico Madrid and Arsenal travel to Napoli. Huge tests for both English sides!

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Roger Waters!
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder and legendary musician Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6th.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Roger Waters! What's your favourite Pink Floyd album or solo track?

moments.title: Happy 83rd Birthday, Gloria Gaynor!
moments.blurb: Disco icon Gloria Gaynor, famous for 'I Will Survive', turns 83 on September 7th.

angles.name: Disco Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the incredible Gloria Gaynor! Still surviving and thriving. What's your favourite disco anthem?

moments.title: Happy 75th Birthday, Chrissie Hynde!

angles.name: Pretenders Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders track to rock out to?

moments.title: Happy 47th Birthday, P!nk!
moments.blurb: Pop-rock superstar P!nk turns 47 on September 8th, known for her powerful vocals and energetic performances.

angles.name: P!nk's Birthday

moments.title: Happy 51st Birthday, Michael Bublé!

angles.name: Bublé's Birthday

angles.name: Bananarama Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Siobhan Fahey! From Bananarama to Shakespears Sister, what's your favourite track featuring her iconic voice?

moments.blurb: Heritage Open Days, offering thousands of free events and access to historic sites across England, run from September 11th to 20th.

angles.name: Explore Hidden History
angles.copy: Unlock England's past! Heritage Open Days kick off on Friday, offering free access to incredible historic sites. Where will you explore?

moments.title: Worcester Music Festival
moments.blurb: The Worcester Music Festival, the UK's largest donation-entry festival, runs from September 11th to 13th, featuring over 250 performances.

angles.name: Music for a Cause
angles.copy: Discover new talent and support a great cause! Worcester Music Festival starts Friday with hundreds of artists. Who's going?

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Moby!
moments.blurb: Electronic music pioneer Moby celebrates his 61st birthday on September 11th.

angles.name: Moby's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the influential Moby! What's the Moby track that always takes you back?

moments.title: Happy 45th Birthday, Jennifer Hudson!
moments.blurb: Oscar and Grammy-winning singer and actress Jennifer Hudson turns 45 on September 12th.

angles.name: J-Hud's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending a huge Happy 45th Birthday to the incredible Jennifer Hudson! What's your favourite song from her amazing career?

moments.title: Reminisce Festival 2026

angles.name: 90s/00s Dance Festival
angles.copy: Get ready to relive the rave! Reminisce Festival is back this Saturday in St Helens for a massive 90s and 00s dance party. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: London's First Pickle Festival
moments.blurb: The Big Brine, London's first pickle and fermentation festival, takes place at Hackney Bridge on September 12th and 13th.

angles.name: Pickle Fest London
angles.copy: Pickle fans, this is for you! London's first ever Big Brine festival is this weekend at Hackney Bridge. Are you a pickle person?

moments.title: Happy 33rd Birthday, Niall Horan!

angles.name: Niall's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the lovely Niall Horan! What's your favourite solo track from the One Direction star?

moments.title: Great North Run 2026
moments.blurb: The iconic Great North Run half marathon takes place in NewcastleGateshead on Sunday, September 13th.

angles.name: Good Luck Great North Runners
angles.copy: Good luck to everyone taking on the Great North Run this Sunday! The atmosphere in NewcastleGateshead is going to be electric. Are you running or cheering?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Buzz Builds
moments.blurb: The launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is expected on September 19th, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe creating a buzz ahead of the series.

angles.name: Strictly New Hosts
angles.copy: Strictly Come Dancing is just around the corner! The big news is Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are the new hosts. Thoughts?

angles.name: Strictly Buzz
angles.copy: The Strictly glitterball is almost ready! Buzz is building for the new series. Who are you hoping to see on the dancefloor this year?
